result.title: CoReFlow: Consistency-Relaxed Flow Maps for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting
result.summary: Probabilistic traffic forecasting is essential for reliable Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), as it captures uncertainties in complex road networks. Recent diffusion- and flow-based generative models have facilitated uncertainty modeling through a multi-step sampling process. However, beyond slow inference, this process is designed to capture complex multimodal distributions, which misaligns with the limited complexity of the conditional traffic data distribution, causing models to underperform deterministic baselines. To address this, we introduce the \underline{Co}nsistency-\underline{Re}laxed \underline{Flow} Map (CoReFlow) model, presenting the first effort to leverage the one-step generation capability of flow maps, known as solution operators of probability-flow ordinary differential equations. Besides, we improve accuracy using a concise training objective that supervises the model via interpolation endpoints over finite time intervals. Unlike existing methods (e.g., self-distillation and MeanFlow Identity) that maintain trajectory consistency to model multimodal distributions, our objective leverages conditional mean to restrict the consistency, thereby achieving higher accuracy in the probabilistic traffic forecasting task. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show CoReFlow achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy. It surpasses recent baselines, provides competitive uncertainty modeling, and reduces inference costs compared to existing generative baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 面向概率交通预测，提出 CoReFlow 模型，利用 flow map 作为概率流 ODE 的解算子实现一步生成，并用有限时间区间插值端点的简洁目标进行训练；相比自蒸馏、MeanFlow Identity 等保持轨迹一致性的做法，改为以条件均值限制一致性，在四个真实数据集上取得更高精度并降低推理成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「放宽轨迹一致性、以条件均值约束换取少步/一步生成」的训练目标，可能为 diffusion 或 parallel 类 latent 推理状态的生成与更新、以及在推理步数与精度间取舍提供可供核查的线索；但论文场景是交通预测，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。
